answer.headline: The US dollar's gain in rate-shock weeks was small and not reliable.
answer.text:
MINOR — The US dollar's gain in rate-shock weeks was small and not reliable.

- Shock: I used the market-level rate-shock weeks (US 10-year yield jump, no stock crash). At the main threshold set there were 60 weeks [measured].
- Step: USD/CAD averaged +0.18% [measured] in those weeks. It rose in 37 weeks [measured] of 60 [measured], with p = 0.09 [measured]. None of the three threshold sets was significant (0 [measured]).
